in_arabic.name: إِنَايَاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: إِنَايَاء: نِسْوةً مِنَ الِخِلَافِ، وَهِيَ الَّتِي تَغُفِّلُ عَنِ الجَزِلَةِ، وَتَنَظُرُ إِلَى الَّتِي تَقُولُ وَلا يَشُكُّ فِيهَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ يُفَسِّقُونَ، وَهِيَ خَاصَةٌ بِإِحسانِهِ إِلَيها، وَتَشُكُّ بِهِ إِلى الَّذينَ يَشُمُّونَ، وَتَقولُ وَهَذِهِ أَخَواتُكُمُ أُولَئِكَ الَّذينَ يَقُولونَ لَكُمُ هَذا حَسبُكُمْ، وَلَمّا يَكُن لَهُمُ بِكُمُ وَلا لَكُمُ بِهِمُ عَلَيهِمُ مَحجُورَةٌ، وَهُمُ عَلَيهِ لَم يَكُن لَهُمُ مُؤمِنَةٌ، وَلا لَهُ مُؤمِنٌ، وَهِيَ خَلِفَةٌ لَهُ وَبِهِ لَهُ وَصِيَتُهُ، وَهِيَ عَلى وَجْهِهِ وَصِيَتُهُ، وَهِيَ عَلى وَجْهِهِ وَصِيَتُهُ

in_english.name: Enaaya
in_english.long_meaning: Enaaya: this name is suitable for a woman who guides her husband towards the right path and provides him with knowledge. This name is also suitable for a woman who guides her sisters towards the right path and provides them with knowledge. The name Enaaya is derived from the Arabic root 'n-y-' which means guidance and knowledge. In Islamic tradition, Enaaya is considered a virtuous name that symbolizes a woman's role in guiding her loved ones towards the right path.

This name is often given to girls who are expected to embody these qualities and make a positive impact on the world around them by providing help, support, and aid to others whenever they can. The name can also serve as a reminder of the moral obligation of Muslims to care for the needy and uplift their community.

According to Islamic traditions, serving others and providing aid is considered an act of worship and a way to please God. Nurturing a compassionate and selfless spirit not only enriches one's own life but also helps in creating a better and more harmonious world. Enaaya is a reminder of the spiritual calling to be kind, loving, and helpful, and to strive towards attaining nearness to God by serving humanity.
